title: Shinonome Ena — The Animal From My Memory〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Paint What I Love♪ Rainbow Canvas

rows.Line: Emu's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
In that case...
Why don't we eat these apples?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I just bought them on my way over here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! Then, we should have them cut up! Oh, we'll need drinks too!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting!
Here are your apples!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thank... Wait, huh?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wh-What happened?! They were just apples that I bought at the supermarket! How did they become this gorgeous?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. I asked the chef to cut them up to look like bunnies, but they said some variety would help make it look more fun. And this is what they made♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We also got some nice, hot drinks to go with them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ta-daa! Special apple tea made from the skins of these apples!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wow, this smells so nice...
This was really made from the apples I bought?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't believe it either. How did those apples turn into something this delectable?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot. It's supposed to be really yummy as is, but also good with a little sugar. The chef even said you can make milk tea out of it by using milk and cinnamon!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, what?! Those both sound amazing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to try both as well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Emu, I can take it from here.
Can you hand me those teacups?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, really?! Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, I should take a picture...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, let's...♪

rows.Speaker: Ena & Honami
rows.Line: Dig in!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Grrr! I'm gonna gobble you up, my little bunny!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is she pretending to be a lion...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I believe so.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Mmm. They're just plain, old apples from the supermarket, but they're so good!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they are... Oh, the surface of these slices looks very juicy.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, they do! I thought they'd be more yellow, but it's a lot closer to white.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like you're both still in sketching mode.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. We totally are!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I think that's a good thing. Sketching really teaches you how to take a closer look at everything you see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Then, I wanna do these kinds of scrumptious sketches every day!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's try doing this again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What's about to be in season...?
Oh, how about sweet potatoes?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah! They're delicious when roasted or made into desserts!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And the chef can always turn it into something even yummier!

rows.Speaker: Ena, Emu & Honami
rows.Line: Haha!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Scrumptious sketches, huh...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Huh...? My hand is moving without hesitation for some reason...
I've had so much on my mind lately...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm gonna keep going for a bit longer...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's done...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My perspective's all messed up, and so are the details... I bet Mr. Yukihira's gonna have a field day with this one... But...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I like what I've made.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I felt the same thing after I came from home that kindergarten...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But it's like I can just have fun and really enjoy art when I'm drawing with those two.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Hehe. I have a feeling that I'll be able to draw something really good again today.)
